text:
Situation: Polyethylene glycol 3350 and electrolytes with orange flavor is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale Lakeside holds 15 units with 8.9 days on hand. Corvale General holds 271 units with 27.7 days on hand and can spare 9 units while keeping at least two weeks of supply. Corvale East holds 182 units with 24.9 days on hand and can also spare 9 units. The top-ranked action is to transfer 9 units from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside, raising Lakeside to about 14 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): The product label identifies Strides Pharma Science Limited as the labeler and names a registered plant (FEI 3004554612) in India. FDA's most recent inspection of that plant ended on 2026-05-20 and was classified VAI, with the classification known on 2026-08-14. FDA's drug shortage list does not include this product as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Internal supply is sufficient to cover the Lakeside shortfall through inter-site transfer. No external purchase is required at this time. The product carries a "To Be Discontinued" status without a listed date; we will monitor for formal discontinuation notices.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 9 units from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — needs pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. If General cannot release units, transfer 9 units from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside — needs pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. Monitor FDA shortage list and Strides discontinuation timeline weekly — needs buyer.

Not recommended: Purchasing from Affordable Pharmaceuticals, LLC; Aurobindo Pharma Limited; or Azurity Pharmaceuticals, Inc. None are on FDA's shortage list today and their labels name no identifiable plant for quality assessment.
